entries.title: Psalms 33:1
segments: ¶Rejoice in the LORD, O you righteous! [For] praise from the upright is beautiful.

entries.title: Psalms 33:2
segments: Praise the LORD with the harp; Make melody to Him with an instrument of ten strings.

entries.title: Psalms 33:3
segments: Sing to Him a new song; Play skillfully with a shout of joy.

entries.title: Psalms 33:4
segments: For the word of the LORD [is] right, And all His work [is done] in truth.

entries.title: Psalms 33:5
segments: He loves righteousness and justice; The earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 33:6
segments: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, And all the host of them by the breath of His mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 33:7
segments: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap; He lays up the deep in storehouses.

entries.title: Psalms 33:8
segments: Let all the earth fear the LORD; Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of Him.

entries.title: Psalms 33:9
segments: For He spoke, and it was [done]; He commanded, and it stood fast.

entries.title: Psalms 33:10
segments: The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing; He makes the plans of the peoples of no effect.

entries.title: Psalms 33:11
segments: The counsel of the LORD stands forever, The plans of His heart to all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 33:12
segments: ¶Blessed [is] the nation whose God [is] the LORD, The people He has chosen as His own inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 33:13
segments: The LORD looks from heaven; He sees all the sons of men.

entries.title: Psalms 33:14
segments: From the place of His dwelling He looks On all the inhabitants of the earth;

entries.title: Psalms 33:15
segments: He fashions their hearts individually; He considers all their works.

entries.title: Psalms 33:16
segments: No king [is] saved by the multitude of an army; A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

entries.title: Psalms 33:17
segments: A horse [is] a vain hope for safety; Neither shall it deliver [any] by its great strength.

entries.title: Psalms 33:18
segments: Behold, the eye of the LORD [is] on those who fear Him, On those who hope in His mercy,

entries.title: Psalms 33:19
segments: To deliver their soul from death, And to keep them alive in famine.

entries.title: Psalms 33:20
segments: Our soul waits for the LORD; He [is] our help and our shield.

entries.title: Psalms 33:21
segments: For our heart shall rejoice in Him, Because we have trusted in His holy name.

entries.title: Psalms 33:22
segments: Let Your mercy, O LORD, be upon us, Just as we hope in You.
